Always expand early.
Always build if safe.
Always defend home when attacked.
Always defend border when outnumbered.
Always talk early.
Always propose to ally early.
Always keep promises.
Always tell the truth.
Always trust allies unless betrayed.
Expect others to lie sometimes.
Always distrust players who break promises.
Always distrust players who lie.
Always punish players who attack.
Always punish players who betray.
Never forgive betrayal unless needed to survive.
Always support allies when safe.
Always support allies when needed.
Never betray allies early.
Only betray allies late if needed to win.
Only betray allies late if leader.
Always attack leader late.
Always balance against leader late.
Avoid attacking weak players unless needed to survive.
Avoid attacking weak players unless gain.
If threaten, defend.
Once strong, expand.
Once strong, hold until win.
